request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:KNIGHT

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: a cheerful chocolatier's kingdom of living sweets, rich, glossy and silly. Its fixed colours: glossy dark chocolate, colour #4a2412, and milk chocolate, colour #7a4526, as the dark anchor on every piece (a dipped half, a shield, a glaze, boots, a roof); golden caramel and toffee, colour #e0a040; vanilla cream and marshmallow white, colour #fff1d0; pale biscuit wafer; a few small jewel-candy accents in amber, mint green and cherry pink; one hard pure white highlight on every glossy surface.
layers.negative: crimson, red, magenta, hot pink, neon pink, purple, violet, all-pink body, pink blob, pastel pink frosting everywhere, metal armour, steel, iron, sword, fur, bone, skull, scary, horror, realistic, banana guard, giant humanoid guardian robot with a gumball head, pink-haired princess, lab coat with a crown, peppermint butler, lemon-headed figure, cartoon show character

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute toy-like machine map piece, a single vehicle or device with big simple rounded shapes and one oversized signature feature, thick single-colour black outline; the whole machine is visible, and its lowest part is the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Subject: a chunky cute gingerbread rocking horse with a small rider: one big rocking horse cut from thick warm brown gingerbread biscuit, colour #b8703a, piped with white icing lines and a white icing mane and tail, standing on two curved dark chocolate rockers, colour #4a2412, with a caramel gold saddle; riding it, one small living toffee sweet, a golden toffee cube with two black dot eyes, a determined smile and two cream wrapper ends, holding one long candy-cane lance with cream white and caramel gold stripes and a hooked top, pointed forward; two short white speed lines behind the horse; the horse is much bigger than its rider; simple shapes and very few details; the rockers are the lowest thing in the image.
The rocking horse is drawn large and fills most of the width of the image.
layers.negative: human, person, child, skin, hair, armour of metal, sword, tiny figure, thin, real horse, fur, knight in armour, wheels, red stripes, pink
